description: This file contains test cases for SSE transport functionality in a Playwright-based client-server setup, including connection lifecycle, browser lifecycle, shared context, and configuration scenarios.

methods.name: test
methods.description: A test harness configured with various lifecycle scenarios for SSE transport and client interactions.

methods.name: serverEndpoint
